name: Jariel Balberona
headline: Staff-Level Software Engineer | AI-Native Product & Platform Engineering
summary: Staff-level software engineer with 10+ years of experience building and modernizing production products across frontend, backend, mobile, cloud, and delivery infrastructure. Strong in TypeScript, React and Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, multi-tenant SaaS, offline-first systems, AWS, Azure, automated QA, observability, and production operations. Designs AI-native engineering workflows that turn scoped product intent into repository-grounded implementation, deterministic verification, bounded correction, and controlled release decisions.

experience.summary: Own product direction, architecture, implementation, verification, and cloud delivery for a multi-tenant hospitality platform.
highlights: Architect and build connected point-of-sale, ordering, kitchen, inventory, and merchant workflows across web and mobile clients.
Design offline-first synchronization, shared-device recovery, tenant boundaries, and real-time propagation for intermittent connectivity and live venue operations.
Own frontend, backend, data, infrastructure, automated testing, runtime verification, and production release decisions.
Establish repository-grounded agent workflows with scoped execution, deterministic quality gates, runtime evidence, bounded correction, and explicit release controls.

experience.summary: Modernized a mature construction project-management platform while preserving established production behavior.
highlights: Worked with the CTO and design team to shape frontend direction and align architecture, UI implementation, and delivery priorities.
Led incremental modernization from CRA to Vite, SASS to Tailwind CSS v4, and token-based theming while maintaining production compatibility.
Re-architected the frontend into feature-based modules and shifted Redux-heavy server-data flows to TanStack Query and Zustand with structured invalidation and optimistic updates.
Strengthened quality through Vitest, Biome, Husky, regression checks, and stricter modular boundaries; delivered features end to end across frontend and backend.

experience.summary: Built product interfaces for a chat-driven AI analytics platform, focusing on workflow clarity, analytical depth, and product reliability.
highlights: Expanded in-chat analytics rendering for heatmaps, treemaps, stacked bars, and other advanced exploratory visualizations.
Built the Agents V1 orchestration interface, a node-based workflow builder covering data source, prompt, condition, and recipient flows.
Improved asynchronous query progress, result, and failure states so analytical workflows were easier to understand and trust.

experience.role: Senior Software Engineer to DevOps Engineer
experience.summary: Progressed from product engineering into DevOps and cloud-platform work across modernization, delivery systems, observability, and reporting infrastructure.
highlights: Modernized an established product through incremental adoption of Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Jotai, tRPC, and Prisma while preserving its existing database and production behavior.
Improved React performance and frontend responsiveness through stronger state, data-fetching, and rendering discipline.
Built and maintained CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure automation with Terraform and Docker, improving release repeatability and reducing manual operational work.
Supported production observability with Grafana, Prometheus, and Loki, plus cloud data-platform and reporting work across AWS and Azure.

experience.summary: Led frontend engineering for a service-booking platform covering customer, appointment, and scheduling workflows.
highlights: Owned frontend structure and hands-on delivery across customer-facing booking and scheduling workflows.
Improved data-fetching behavior with Apollo Client and added error tracking and analytics instrumentation.
Established maintainable component and delivery patterns that supported continued product growth.
